required_checks: Separate snapshot period end, publication date/time and retrieval time; filing date alone cannot support same-day decision availability.
For PE/EP record issuer aggregation, treatment of loss makers, denominator/coverage and whether historical values are revised.
SOXX historical holdings and SOX index constituents are distinct; preserve the 2021 benchmark change and exact benchmark identity.
Rebalance announcement time, effective time and actual holdings report availability must remain separate.
Report both useful observations and missing vintage history; no current-constituent or period-end backfill.
Do not infer qualified full history from three accessible probe dates; missing source gates affect this branch only.
limitations: No investment/promotion conclusion from source discovery.
Sources may supply documentary or partial research evidence without furnishing a tradable monthly feature.
